artifacts.description: Added ClassRangeService, new DTOs (ClassRangeRequest, RangeMetric, ShipMetricSummary, ClassRangeResponse), updated existing DTOs with new fields (PhysicsRequest.shipId, PhysicsResponse.topSpeed/acceleration, EnginePerformance top speeds, ShipDetails new fields), added classRangeApi to Frontend Services, added useClassRange hook, updated TypeScript types

Added ClassRangeEndpoint.php, ClassRangeService.php, 4 new DTOs, useClassRange.ts hook, RangeBar.tsx, AbsoluteMetricCard.tsx, WorstCaseCard.tsx, ClassRangePanel.tsx components, metricContext.ts utility, PhysicsOverview.tsx, EnginePerformanceDisplay.tsx updated
Added Class-Wide Range Calculation Flow section with complete flow diagram, timeline, performance optimizations, and comparison table vs single-ship calculation
Added Class-Wide Aggregation Pattern (pattern #9) with implementation details, frontend integration, benefits, and key optimizations
Updated Debounce Delays section with table showing both single-ship (300ms) and class-range (500ms) values with rationales
Added POST /api/calculate/class-range endpoint documentation with complete request/response examples, parameters table, response fields, and notes. Renumbered subsequent endpoints 4-11

pipelines.summary: Successfully updated all GUI project manifest documents and API documentation to reflect features added in WP-001 through WP-007. Updated public-api.md with ClassRangeService, 4 new DTOs, classRangeApi, useClassRange hook, and extended existing DTOs with readonly properties and new fields for absolute metrics. Added 11 new files to file-tree.md (endpoints, services, DTOs, components, hooks, utilities). Created comprehensive Class-Wide Range Calculation Flow section in data-flows.md with timeline and performance comparison. Documented Class-Wide Aggregation Pattern in tech-stack.md as pattern #9. Updated constraints.md with debounce values table (300ms vs 500ms). Added complete class-range endpoint documentation to API.md with examples. All 'Last Updated' dates refreshed to February 15, 2026. All 7 acceptance criteria met. No contradictions between manifest and code.

comments.note: Version numbers incremented from 1.0 to 1.1 in all updated manifest documents (public-api.md, file-tree.md, data-flows.md, tech-stack.md, constraints.md, API.md).
public-api.md: Added readonly keyword to all DTO property signatures to match PHP 8.4 code. This reflects the immutability constraint from constraints.md.
data-flows.md: Class-range flow diagram includes performance timeline showing 500ms debounce + ~80ms backend processing = ~580ms avg user experience, meeting <600ms target.
tech-stack.md: Class-Wide Aggregation Pattern documented with complete PHP and TypeScript implementation examples showing integration with separate 500ms debounce hook.

API.md: Class-range endpoint documentation includes real-world example with 78 ships showing Colossus (L-class) as worst case and Tern (M-class) as best case, matching typical Transport ship distribution.
All TypeScript interfaces updated to match backend DTOs exactly, including optional fields (?:), nullable unions (| null), and nested object structures for topSpeed/acceleration metrics.
